PART I

Item 1. Business

Northwind Logistics Inc. provides freight transportation services in the U.S. and Canada. We use machine learning models to forecast freight demand at 85 depots. In 2024 we deployed an AI-powered routing engine across our network.

Artificial intelligence is transforming the logistics industry. We employed approximately 8,200 people.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

If our AI models contain errors, our business could be adversely affected. Competitors may use AI to offer lower prices.

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Revenue increased 6% compared with the prior year. Our AI-powered routing engine reduced fuel consumption by 7%.
